use_deprecated_call: use the deprecated_call helper to catch deprecation warnings in pytest tests across versions
check_LINUX_constant: check the LINUX constant to conditionally skip tests on non-Linux platforms
check_MACOS_constant: check the MACOS constant to conditionally skip tests on non-macOS platforms
check_WIN_constant: check the WIN constant to conditionally skip tests on non-Windows platforms
check_PY_version: check the PY version_info tuple to conditionally skip tests based on Python version
